reponse: We’re still negotiating. Orbitly asked for a 15% renewal discount; we proposed 8% off in exchange for a 2-year term plus quarterly invoicing. Orbitly’s Jonas Pike recorded that we agreed to a 20% discount and EU data residency by March 2027, but that hasn’t been formally confirmed in our internal threads [2][3]. A call to finalize is scheduled for Nov 24 [2].
